_comment: Every number that appears on the landing page lives here, once, with the
kind of statement it is (ADR-038 Decision 1) and — for a cited fact — the
source whose own wording it matches. The build reads this file to fill in
copy and to generate the squares/ticks; scripts/check-devices.mjs reads the
built HTML and refuses to pass if a rendered count and this file disagree.
Nothing here is a placeholder: if a figure cannot be defended at this level
of care, it does not get an entry, and the page does not get a device.
ADR-038 Amendment 1 (Kihea, on issue #89): the opening statistic is the
NCES/PIAAC 48% — 'true and accurate' was the whole criterion, and it needs
no third-party gloss the way the Gallup 54% needed PIAAC's own units
substituted for a phrase PIAAC discourages. `opening` replaces the old
`variantA`/`variantB` split; there is one page now, not two plus a
compare view. The headline text below was checked directly against
NCES's own description of PIAAC Level 3
paraphrase of it — the draft's 'compare, contrast and reason about what
they have read' was itself a gloss NCES never wrote, caught the same way
the sixth-grade phrasing was: by opening the source instead of trusting

opening.headline: of US adults aged 16–65 hold meaning together across a longer piece of writing — PIAAC's Level 3 or above.
opening.citation: National Center for Education Statistics, U.S. results from the OECD's PIAAC survey, 2017.

session.headline: A session is about six minutes.
session.deviceCaption: six minutes, not a fraction of anything else.

mechanism.headline: A word you tap comes back until it’s yours.
mechanism.deviceCaption: no figure here — the mechanism replaces one that would have had to be invented (ADR-038 Decision 4).
